name: bb-lsp-vscode
description: Honest code navigation from the Backbencher index: hover with evidence tier and staleness, definition, references, symbols, call hierarchy. A complement to your editor's own language servers — graph, navigation, and evidence only.

bbLsp.serverPath.description: Explicit path to the bb_lsp server entry (dist/lsp/server.js). Empty = auto-resolve from the workspace's backbencher-brain checkout, then the bundled copy.

bbLsp.sourceMode.description: How to launch the server: compiled dist (preferred), from source via bun (declared fallback), or auto (dist if resolvable, else bun source).

bbLsp.minServerVersion.description: Minimum bb_lsp server version this extension accepts (version-compatibility matrix, contract §2 honesty).

bbLsp.activationBudgetMs.description: Declared activation budget in milliseconds (contract §7.3). Measured activate()-to-ready time is recorded; a budget miss is a failed gate.

enumDescriptions: Ask for consent before building an index (scale estimate shown first).
Never index automatically; features stay off until an index exists.
bbLsp.autoIndexMode.description: Auto-index behavior on workspace open (issue #500). Indexing never starts without explicit consent.

enumDescriptions: Open hub/impact/graph panels as a tab in the current editor group, no split (default; the owner's decision).
Open panels beside the current editor, splitting the group (the pre-M55 behaviour).
Not implemented for webview panels: resolves to activeGroup and says so rather than silently doing nothing.
Not implemented for webview panels: resolves to activeGroup and says so rather than silently doing nothing.
bb.panelPlacement.description: Where Backbencher hub, impact and graph panels open (issue #776). Panels are reused, never duplicated, and informational panels never move the cursor.
